mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in < 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in non-farm payrolls signals a strong labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of UNRATE decline and PAYEMS increase fails to produce positive 20d returns in > 50% of cases (Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: When consumer spending (RSAFS) exceeds 380,000 million dollars, it signals robust household demand that supports corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in < 55% of instances when RSAFS > 380000.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index indicates strong economic output and corporate activity, supporting earnings growth and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in < 50% of instances when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC < 0.04 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0%, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in < 45% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a strong consumer and housing market, boosting economic growth and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of RSAFS increase and HOUST increase fails to produce positive 20d returns in > 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in < 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0.
